 Cricket SYTW vs BRHW Head to Head Stats and Records in WBBL
 Liam Carter
 October 31, 2026. 7 MIN READ 
 Sydney Thunder Women and Brisbane Heat Women have met 25 times in the Women’s Big Bash League since 2015, and only one win separates them. Brisbane lead the SYTW vs BRHW head to head 13 wins to 12, with no washouts, and the two sides have also met four times in finals. 
 Below is every result with its scores, the key records, and the two WBBL 2026 meetings at Drummoyne Oval and Allan Border Field.
 Sydney Thunder Women vs Brisbane Heat Women Head-to-Head Summary
 This table shows how the two sides compare across every WBBL meeting.
 Team Matches Wins Losses Win % No Result 
 Brisbane Heat Women 25 13 12 52.00% 0 
 Sydney Thunder Women 25 12 13 48.00% 0 
 Every one of the 25 meetings has produced a result, which is rare across a decade of WBBL scheduling.
 (Source: Cricbuzz, ESPNcricinfo)

 Thunder Women vs Heat Women WBBL 2026 Fixtures
 Source: CricTracker 
 The two clubs meet twice in the regular season of the WBBL 2026 schedule , first at Drummoyne Oval on Sunday afternoon and then under lights at Allan Border Field.
 Match Date Venue Local Time AEDT ACDT AWST 
 6th Match Sunday, 1 November 2026 Drummoyne Oval, Sydney 3:40 PM AEDT 3:40 PM 3:10 PM 12:40 PM 
 27th Match Thursday, 19 November 2026 Allan Border Field, Brisbane 6:10 PM AEST 7:10 PM 6:40 PM 4:10 PM 
 Brisbane viewers can tune in at 2:40 PM AEST for the Drummoyne match. Every WBBL|12 game is on Kayo Sports and Foxtel, with 20 regular-season matches also free on Seven and 7plus.
 The Thunder arrive with a win already banked after beating the Renegades by six wickets in the season opener, while the Heat are coming off a last-ball loss to the Sixers on Friday night.
 (Source: Brisbane Heat, ESPNcricinfo, SBS)

 Thunder Women vs Heat Women Record by Venue
 Sydney has staged 11 of the 25 meetings, Queensland eight and neutral venues six.

 North Sydney Oval has been a Thunder stronghold in this rivalry at 4-0, but Sunday’s venue tells a different story. The Heat have won two of three at Drummoyne Oval, including the 2019 semi-final.
 (Source: Cricbuzz, ESPNcricinfo)
 Thunder Women vs Heat Women Finals Record
 Few WBBL rivalries have produced as many knockout meetings, and Brisbane have won three of the four.
 Date Stage Venue Result 
 19 Jan 2019 Semi-final Drummoyne Oval, Sydney Brisbane Heat Women won by 4 runs 
 26 Nov 2020 Semi-final North Sydney Oval, Sydney Sydney Thunder Women won by 12 runs 
 28 Nov 2023 Eliminator WACA Ground, Perth Brisbane Heat Women won by 44 runs 
 29 Nov 2024 Challenger Allan Border Field, Brisbane Brisbane Heat Women won by 9 wickets 
 The 2019 semi-final win sent the Heat to the final they won against the Sixers, while the Thunder went on to claim the WBBL|06 title after their 2020 semi-final victory.
 (Source: Cricbuzz)
 Thunder Women vs Heat Women Trends and Form
 A few patterns stand out once the results sit in date order.
 Neither side has ever won more than two meetings in a row, across 25 matches and a decade of competition.
 The side batting first has won 16 of 25 matches, against 9 for the chasing side, and has won six of the last seven.
 Sydney Thunder Women won both 2025 meetings, by 41 and 23 runs, and enter WBBL 2026 with the head to head momentum.
 Thunder have passed 200 twice in this fixture, both since 2023, while the Heat’s best is 196/5.
 The Thunder hold a 7-4 record in Sydney, but the Heat lead 9-5 everywhere else.
 Both line-ups have shifted since last summer, and the WBBL 2026 squads show the Heat under new captain Georgia Redmayne after a winless WBBL|11.
 (Source: Cricbuzz, ESPNcricinfo)
 Brisbane Heat Women Lead the Sydney Thunder Women Head to Head 13 Wins to 12 in the WBBL
 This is about as even as a WBBL rivalry gets: 25 completed matches, a one-win gap, and no side able to string three wins together. The Heat have had the upper hand when it matters most, winning three of four finals, while the Thunder have won the last two and dominate at North Sydney Oval.
 Two meetings in 19 days give either side the chance to reshape the record. If the Thunder win both, they will lead this head to head for the first time since… the numbers are worth checking on 19 November. Results here run up to 3 December 2025 and will be updated after each match.
